summaryZh: SEE Lab 研究如何在资源受限边缘设备上高效运行机器学习，并在精度、能耗与计算资源之间协调。团队跨系统层面开发学习算法、优化新硬件并分配计算与通信，也采用超维计算建立高效分类和聚类方法。
researchQuestions: 如何在满足嵌入式边缘设备资源约束的同时实现高准确率机器学习？

evidence.quote: research in SEE Lab tackles these questions across all levels of system design, using novel algorithmic approaches for machine learning, developing optimized hardware based on emerging technologies, and distributing computation and communication throughout a system to extend system lifetime.
Our work leverages the paradigm of “hyperdimensional computing” (HD)

However, these algorithms are often too computationally demanding to run on resource-constrained edge devices, which lack the required power and computation resources, necessitating the development of novel algorithmic techniques which can deliver high accuracy while meeting the resource constraints of embedded devices. research in SEE Lab tackles these questions across all levels of system design
